question: Which remaining skill ecosystem contracts should OpenClaw own versus ClawHub/plugins, and which narrow trackers should replace or continue this umbrella?
rationale: The unresolved work defines public metadata, trust/security semantics, install/update lifecycle hooks, and possible ClawHub service behavior; automation cannot safely choose those ownership and compatibility boundaries.

options.title: Split Under Existing Umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open as a consolidation tracker while maintainers assign scoped OpenClaw issues for permission manifests, trigger metadata, lifecycle hooks, and ClawHub publish ownership.

options.title: Promote One Canonical Tracker
options.body: Choose a narrower open issue such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/12219 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54799 as the canonical OpenClaw contract and close this umbrella after explicitly moving the remaining bullets there.

options.title: Route To ClawHub Only
options.body: Close the OpenClaw issue as external ClawHub ecosystem work, accepting that OpenClaw-side API/security gaps may need new issues later.

recommendation.title: Split Under Existing Umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as a consolidation tracker while maintainers assign scoped OpenClaw issues for permission manifests, trigger metadata, lifecycle hooks, and ClawHub publish ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a product/security boundary decision across skills, plugins, and ClawHub, and steipete is the strongest current-history routing signal for those surfaces.
